notes.title: Halloween Mega Update!
Release Update and Keys Giveaway!
notes.content:
Our first update is here. Here is some things that we change and improve in the game:

- General GUI.
- Better focus.
- Progression.

We also want your participation by giving your opinions on the game in review format. To this end, we are encouraging those who review Hentai Fight Club by giving them a free key to one of our other games. Just review and contact us. :)

We look forward to your collaboration and feedback to bring you the best of our games.
